Plot modules (horizontal layout)

Source: R/plot_modules_h.R
plot_modules_h.Rd

Plot WGCNA modules' heatmaps, mean expression profiles, and enrichment terms, aligned horizontally.

Different from running WGCNA, the input data should have the replicates merged, instead of having multiple samples per group, time and feature (gene).

If certain time points are missing in some groups, NA values are added.

Usage

plot_modules_h(
  module,
  se_obj_merged,
  scale = TRUE,
  assay,
  ylabel = NULL,
  profile_width = 3,
  profile_link_width = 1,
  enrich_list = NULL,
  enrich_category = NULL,
  enrich_rank_by = "p.adjust",
  enrich_top_n = 3,
  enrich_threshold = 0.05,
  enrich_wrap_width = NULL,
  fontsize = 8,
  group_annotation = c("name", "colour", "both", "none"),
  return_legends = FALSE,
  profile_scale = c("dataset", "shared", "free"),
  heatmap_width = 8,
  heatmap_height = 8,
  mark_features = NULL,
  width = 16,
  height = 12,
  res = 300,
  suffix = "",
  device = "png",
  save = NULL,
  names = NULL,
  selected_modules = NULL,
  legend_position = c("right", "bottom"),
  feature_colours = NULL
)

Arguments

module

A data frame with columns "Feature" and "Module"

se_obj_merged

A SummarizedExperiment object, with one value for each feature at each time point in each group (replicates merged), or a named list of such objects (one per dataset). The colData of each object should contain columns "Sample", "Group", and "Time". The object can be produced by split_groups(), merge_replicates() and merge_groups().

scale

Whether to scale the data (z-score) across samples for each feature (default is TRUE)

assay

The assay to use in the SummarizedExperiment object: a numeric index or character name, e.g. 1 or "orig" for original data, 2 or "norm" for time 0 normalised data. (Required, no default.)

ylabel

Y axis label. A single character string shared by all datasets. Default: NULL, i.e. "Z-score of log2 abundance" when scale = TRUE, "Log2 abundance" otherwise.

profile_width

Width of the mean expression profile panels in cm (default: 3)

profile_link_width

Width of the link between heatmap and mean expression profile panels in cm (default: 1)

enrich_list

A named enrichment list for modules, as produced by enrichGO_list()$all. Each named element should be a data.frame with columns Cluster, Description, and the rank column. Accepts any enrichment result with compatible format. When enrich_category is a vector, each category is shown as a separate column in the annotation textbox. If NULL (default), no enrichment terms will be displayed.

enrich_category

Category name(s) of enrichment to display: a single string (e.g. "BP"), or a vector for multiple categories (e.g. c("BP", "CC", "Features")). When "Features" is included, mark_features are shown as a column in the textbox. Categories must be present in enrich_list, except for "Features".

enrich_rank_by

Numeric column used to rank enrichment terms within each module. A single string (default: "p.adjust") is recycled for all categories in enrich_category. Supply a character vector of matching length for per-category control. Also used for colour-coding: terms with values below enrich_threshold are shown in black, terms above in grey.

enrich_top_n

Top N enrichment terms per module. A single integer (default: 3) is recycled for all categories in enrich_category. Supply an integer vector of matching length for per-category control.

enrich_threshold

Threshold for colour-coding enrichment terms (default: 0.05). Terms where enrich_rank_by column value falls below this threshold are drawn in black, terms above in grey. Supply a vector matching enrich_category for per-category control, or set to NULL to skip colour-coding (all terms black). Set to NA for "Features".

enrich_wrap_width

Optional maximum enrichment term width in cm. The default NULL disables wrapping.

fontsize

Base font size (default: 8)

group_annotation

Top annotation for group-split heatmap columns: "name" (default), "colour", "both", or "none". In "both" mode, group names are above the colour strip.

return_legends

Logical; if TRUE, return a list containing the Heatmap/HeatmapList and the native ComplexHeatmap legend objects. (default: FALSE)

profile_scale

Y-axis scaling for the mean expression profiles: "dataset" (default) uses one range across modules within each dataset, "shared" uses one range across all modules and datasets, and "free" uses an independent range for each module.

heatmap_width

Width of the heatmap body in cm (default: 8)

heatmap_height

Height of the heatmap body in cm (default: 8). Set to NULL to auto-size.

mark_features

Features to label. Accepts three forms:

  • A character vector: all marked in black by default on the left.

  • A named list of character vectors, e.g. list("Set 1" = c("gene1"), "Set 2" = c("gene2")). Names become categories with auto-assigned colours (via ggsci::pal_jco()).

  • A data frame with Feature and Set columns, such as the output of extract_consensus_hubs(). Set values become categories. Auto-routed: shown as anno_mark (left side, connecting lines) unless "Features" is present in enrich_category, in which case an anno_multicol_textbox (right side) is built instead, using the same colours. Set to NULL (default) to skip marking.

width

Width of the saved image (default is 16 (cm))

height

Height of the saved image (default is 12 (cm))

res

Resolution of the saved image (except pdf and svg formats) (default: 300 (ppi))

suffix

Suffix for the saved image file name (default: "")

device

Image file format(s) for saving. Can be a character vector with one or more of "png", "pdf", "svg", "tiff", "jpeg" (default: "png")

save

Directory to save the plot, no saving if is NULL (default is NULL)

names

Optional character vector of dataset names for the plot subtitles when multi-dataset. Default: NULL, i.e. the names of se_obj_merged.

selected_modules

Optional character or numeric module labels for which profiles and enrichment panels should be displayed. The default NULL keeps all modules.

legend_position

Legend position: "right" (default) or "bottom".

feature_colours

Optional named character vector of colours for marked feature sets. Names must match feature set names in mark_features. If mark_features is a plain character vector, this parameter is ignored. Omitted sets retain their automatic colours. Default: NULL.

Value

A combined plot of heatmap, mean expression profile, and enrichment terms for each WGCNA module. If return_legends = TRUE, returns a list with elements heatmap and legends instead.

References

https://github.com/junjunlab/ClusterGVis

Examples

data(example_obj)
example_obj <- normalise_to_start(example_obj)
#> Normalising to group baseline at each feature's first non-NA time point.
example_obj_list <- split_groups(example_obj)
example_obj_merged_list <- merge_replicates(example_obj_list)
example_obj_merged <- merge_groups(example_obj_merged_list)

data(example_net)
# select two modules for demonstration
example_module <- WGCNA_module(example_net) |>
    dplyr::filter(Module %in% c("1", "2"))

data(example_go)

plot_modules_h(example_module |> dplyr::filter(Module != '0'),
    example_obj_merged, assay = 2, scale = TRUE,
    ylabel = "Z-score of log2 expression",
    enrich_list = example_go$all,
    enrich_category = "BP",
    heatmap_width = 6, heatmap_height = 4)


plot_modules_h(example_module |> dplyr::filter(Module != '0'),
    list(Exp1 = example_obj_merged, Exp2 = example_obj_merged),
    assay = 2, scale = TRUE,
    enrich_list = example_go$all,
    enrich_category = "BP",
    heatmap_width = 6, heatmap_height = 4)
